body: I mentioned this week over on my Facebook page (I hope you’ll “like” it) that I’ve tried to restrain myself from commenting much on the Presidential Primary Race because, among other reasons, I didn’t want to get sucked into the 24/7 “outrage of the day” cycle. I think there’s a time and place for outrage, of course, but constant daily outrage feels pretty toxic to me (I don’t find “blessed are the constantly outraged” right after “blessed are the poor in spirit”). I’m hearing it on both sides of the aisle and a few in between. So I’ve tried to pay attention without getting sucked into it in an unhealthy way. My political musings inspired some comedic fiction, I guess you would say. Over the next few weeks, you can expect some comic novellas to be available in eBook form. Below is the first cover, a memo of sorts – that will be available Mar. 12th at Amazon. Would love to hear what you think next week.
